prompt: Illustration painted and inked BY HAND on a wood panel — visible wood grain, matte paint, LOOSE HAND-DRAWN PEN HATCHING with natural wobble and rich pen texture. Storybook, illustrative, imperfect, NOT crisp vector. High contrast. Palette strictly: pale bone-grey painted ground, FLAT solid black, white line, ONE accent of glowing BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN. THE CREATURE: small, SOLID BLACK with a thin white outline, STANDING UPRIGHT ON TWO LEGS with small dexterous HANDS it can hold things with, curled spiral fiddlehead ears, ONE GLOWING GREEN EYE, and a few small glowing green tally marks on its shoulder. NO human figures, no text, no lettering. CUTAWAY view into the inside of a spiral burrow home at night — a collector lives here. The stone-lined wall spirals downward and SHELVES ARE BUILT INTO EVERY TURN, following the coil: rows of small cards standing upright in sleeves, stacked archive boxes, jars of tiny treasures, a smooth stone, a seed pod, a coil of copper wire, hand tools hung on pegs, a rolled sleeping mat in a niche, a low work table. At the very bottom centre, GREEN LIGHT wells up from the tapped vein in the floor and lights the whole spiral from below. One creature stands upright on the steps, holding a single card in both hands, looking at it in the green light. Deeply lived-in, warm, full of kept things.
